classification.difficultyReason: Represent each explicit inequality as an endpoint and ray, choosing open/closed and direction directly from its symbol. Fractional endpoints add placement care, not a new method.

content.prompt: Graph each set on the number line.

answer.short: Open dot at $10$; arrow to the right.
answer.worked: The strict inequality excludes $10$. Mark an open dot at $10$ and draw a ray to the right for numbers greater than $10$.
